answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. The onyx is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tide. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
